name: clk-pi-extension
description: Cognitive Loop Kernel as a Pi extension: dynamic casting, stochastic consensus, Ralph + autoresearch behind a single /clk command.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('pi install npm:pi-subagents',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch{console.warn('[clk-pi-extension] could not auto-install pi-subagents; run: pi install npm:pi-subagents')}"
